# HMPFL Week 10 Recap: Lockdown Report

The warden's office is buried in incident reports this week, inmates. Week 10 delivered everything from a nail-biting standoff to a full-blown prison riot on the scoreboard. Let's review the surveillance footage.

## Closest Call: A Near-Escape

**Steve Ruggs** barely slipped past **OJ's Denver Bronco** in the week's tightest contest, 227.05 to 216.2. A margin of just 10.85 points means OJ's crew was one missed field goal away from flipping this one — close enough that you could hear the cell door practically click shut on them. Ruggs' squad lives to see commissary day another week.

## Biggest Blowout: Maximum Security Massacre

If you thought the big house couldn't get any more brutal, meet **DUIiiiiiiii dont know jim**, who absolutely torched **Ruggs, Drugs and TDs** 318.75 to 188.5 — a jaw-dropping 130.25-point margin. That's not a beatdown, that's solitary confinement with no yard time. Ruggs, Drugs and TDs didn't just lose this week, they got transferred to a different facility.

Honorable mention to **Josh Allen's Prison Cell**, who got bodied by **Glove Don't Fit, Blitz** 250.1 to 166.63. The cell doors are definitely not fitting this week.

## Standout Performances: Cell Block Legends

**Christian McCaffrey** put together a 92.6-point masterpiece for **The ConVicks**, pairing with Patrick Mahomes' 77.3 to help blow out The Massage Boys 279.75–236.7. That's a two-man crime spree that should get CMC his own wing named after him.

Not to be outdone, **Jahmyr Gibbs** dropped 82.4 points carrying **DUIiiiiiiii dont know jim** to their record-setting blowout — Gibbs basically tunneled through the yard with a spoon and came out the other side a legend.

Meanwhile **Steve Ruggs** basically ran a quarterback factory, getting 79.5 from Joe Burrow AND 76.6 from Brock Purdy in the same lineup. That's two aces in one deck — practically contraband.

## The Massacre Nobody Saw Coming

**Rice, Rice Baby ✨** absolutely feasted on **Smack my Diggs up**, winning 297.7 to 224.72 despite Diggs' squad getting strong nights from Ja'Marr Chase (74.7) and George Pickens (68.5). Sometimes you put together a great lineup and the other guy just breaks out of max security anyway.

Stay locked up, stay ready — Week 11 awaits, and nobody's getting early parole.
